topic: Write a narrative about helping others(写一篇助人经历的记叙文)
title_en: A Kind Deed I Will Never Forget
genre: 记叙文 / narrative(share a true or imagined experience of helping others)
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 3 Writing:写一篇 100–120 词的记叙文,讲述自己做慈善或做好事帮助他人的一次经历(setting + plot + emotion/lesson)。
prompt_cn: 假设你是李华,学校报社正在征集'帮助他人'的故事。请用英语写一篇约100–120词的记叙文,讲述你做慈善或帮助别人的一次经历。内容包括:① 时间、地点、人物(setting);② 事情经过(开端·发展·高潮·结尾);③ 你的感受或从中得到的启示。注意:动名词作主语/宾语等结构运用得当,行文连贯。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school Newspaper Club is collecting stories about helping others. Write a narrative of about 100–120 words about a time you did charity work or a kind deed. Include: 1) the setting (time, place, people); 2) what happened (beginning, rising action, climax, end); 3) your feelings or the lesson you learned. Use -ing forms (as subject/object) naturally and keep the story connected.
points: 交代背景 setting(时间/地点/人物)
按顺序叙述经过(开端→发展→高潮→结尾)
结尾点出感受或启示(Helping others … / I realised that …)
动名词作主语/宾语等结构运用得当、句句连贯
model_essay: Last winter, I saw an old man selling pencils outside our school gate. He looked cold and tired, and few people stopped to buy from him. Remembering the warm gloves in my bag, I walked over and bought several pencils. Then I quietly gave him my gloves and a cup of hot tea. His face lit up with a bright smile, and he thanked me again and again. That moment filled my heart with warmth. As I walked home, I realised that helping others does not need much money or time. A small act of kindness can warm both the giver and the receiver, even on the coldest day.
model_translation: 去年冬天,我看见一位老人在校门口卖铅笔。他看上去又冷又累,几乎没人停下来买。想起包里温暖的手套,我走过去买了几支铅笔。然后我悄悄把手套和一杯热茶递给他。他的脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容,一遍遍向我道谢。那一刻,我的心里满是温暖。走回家的路上,我意识到帮助别人并不需要很多钱或时间。一个小小的善举,即使在最冷的日子里,也能温暖给予者和接受者双方。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:背景设定 / 完整经过 / 感受或启示
按时间顺序展开、开端发展高潮结尾清晰、句句相关、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、动名词作主语/宾语等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 背景 Last winter, I saw … (setting)
经过 Remembering …, I walked over and … (rising action)
高潮 His face lit up with a bright smile … (climax)
感受/启示 I realised that helping others …

error_pairs.note: enjoy 后只接动名词,不接 to do。

error_pairs.wrong: Thank you for help me that day.
error_pairs.correct: Thank you for helping me that day.
error_pairs.note: 介词 for 后接动名词 helping。
动名词作主语视作单数,谓语用 is。
